athlete_settings_hr_zone_vendor_ck.name: athlete_settings_hr_zone_vendor_ck
athlete_settings_hr_zone_vendor_ck.value: ("athlete_settings"."hr_zone_mode" = 'vendor') = ("athlete_settings"."hr_zone_vendor" is not null) and "athlete_settings"."hr_zone_vendor" is distinct from 'manual'

daily_wellness_ranges_ck.name: daily_wellness_ranges_ck
daily_wellness_ranges_ck.value:
("daily_wellness"."sleep_duration_s" is null or "daily_wellness"."sleep_duration_s" between 0 and 86400)
        and ("daily_wellness"."sleep_score" is null or "daily_wellness"."sleep_score" between 0 and 100)
        and ("daily_wellness"."sleep_quality" is null or "daily_wellness"."sleep_quality" between 1 and 5)
        and ("daily_wellness"."resting_hr" is null or "daily_wellness"."resting_hr" between 20 and 200)
        and ("daily_wellness"."hrv_ms" is null or "daily_wellness"."hrv_ms" between 0 and 500)
        and ("daily_wellness"."vendor_readiness" is null or "daily_wellness"."vendor_readiness" between 0 and 100)
